# Strata Distillation — AutoResearch Program

## Objective
Fine-tune a local model (Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct via QLoRA) to match Gemini 2.5 Flash
extraction/summarization quality on the user's own coding session data.

## Rules
1. The eval script (`eval.py`) is FROZEN. Never modify it during optimization.
2. Change ONE variable per experiment iteration.
3. Record every experiment in `experiments/NNN-description.md`.
4. Keep changes that improve the score. Discard changes that don't.
5. Simpler is better — if equal scores, prefer fewer parameters.
6. Do NOT pause to ask the human if you should continue.

## Mutable Variables (finetune_config.yaml)
- `lora.rank`: 8, 16, 32, 64
- `training.learning_rate`: 1e-4, 2e-4, 5e-4
- `training.epochs`: 2, 3, 5
- `data.min_quality_score`: 0.7, 0.8, 0.9
- `data.heuristic_diverged_only`: true, false

## Success Criteria
- Extraction: F1 >= 90% of frontier baseline
- Summarization: ROUGE-L >= 0.80, count accuracy >= 85%
- JSON validity rate >= 95%

## Time Budget
- 60 minutes per experiment on RTX 4090
- Abort and log as failure if exceeded
